artists.biography: Pop Will Eat Itself (also known as PWEI or The Poppies) are an English alternative rock band, originally formed in Stourbridge in 1986, with members from Birmingham, Coventry and the Black Country. Initially known as a Grebo act, their style changed to incorporate sample driven indie and industrial rock. Their highest charting single was 1993's "Get The Girl! Kill The Baddies!". After initially disbanding in 1996, and having a brief reformation in 2005, they issued their first release in over five years in 2010.

perplexity.description:
Box Frenzy, released in 1987 by English rock band Pop Will Eat Itself on Chapter 22 Records, is the group's debut studio album and a defining work in their early discography. The album blends elements of electronic music, hip hop, and rock, characterized by its innovative use of sampling, driving beats, and a fusion of guitar-driven rock with dance-oriented rhythms. This eclectic mix helped establish Pop Will Eat Itself as pioneers of the alternative dance genre, setting the stage for their subsequent experimentation and evolution.

Musically, Box Frenzy stands out for its energetic tracks, layered production, and genre-defying approach, combining rock instrumentation with electronic textures and hip hop-inspired sampling. The album's standout single, "There Is No Love Between Us Anymore," exemplifies this style and marked a notable increase in the band's commercial visibility, reaching #66 on the UK singles chart. While critical reception at the time was mixed, the album has since been recognized for its originality and influence, cementing its place as a foundational release in Pop Will Eat Itself's career and a notable artifact of late-1980s British alternative music.
